events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Legacy
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! What's your favourite Liam Gallagher moment or lyric?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring his iconic peace anthem.

angles.name: Imagine's Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. Does its message still resonate with you today?

events.title: Apple's first iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got an iPod? Twenty-five years since it changed music forever. What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: It's James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred... Happy James Bond Day! Who's your definitive 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling 'White Album'. Which track from the double LP is your absolute favourite?

events.title: 35 years since the death of Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true legend. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury and his incredible legacy. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965, showcasing a significant evolution in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Evolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles gifted us 'Rubber Soul'. Widely seen as a turning point, what's the standout track for you?

events.title: 46 years since the death of John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles co-founder and peace advocate, John Lennon, on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world.
